title.full: Charges for the Resident Assessment Form

summary.text: Nursing homes do not charge residents for performing the RAF.

details.heading: If you want the RAF
details.body: If the person lives in a nursing home and wants the RAF instead of an MOH-accredited severe disability assessment, approach the nursing home for help.

example_phrasings: Does the nursing home charge for performing the Resident Assessment Form (RAF) for the applicant?
Do nursing homes charge for the RAF?
Is there a fee for the nursing home to do the RAF?

sources.page_title: Does the nursing home charge for performing the Resident Assessment Form (RAF) for the applicant?

quotes.text: Nursing homes do not charge for performing the RAF for their residents.

If the individual resides in a nursing home and would like to undergo the RAF in place of a disability assessment conducted by an MOH-accredited severe disability assessor, please approach the individual’s nursing home for further assistance.
